I tried it out myself and it does what I need. I saved a link with a title, notes, and tags and it showed up in my collection. Searching found it, marking it a favorite and archiving both worked, deleting removed it, and when I tried to save the same link again it stopped me and pointed me at the one I already had. The empty-collection screen is welcoming too, and you've confirmed everything stays saved between sessions and holds up at 5,000 links.

This is exactly the bookmark manager I was after. I'm happy with it as our first version — the automatic title fill-in we agreed to leave for later is the only thing I'd still like down the road.

Accepted.
